name: skyfall-royale
description: Browser 3D battle royale prototype — React Three Fiber + Socket.IO

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
